liam_sales: Customer (MedLedger) confirmed they can only accept USB-delivered artifacts for the POC. They want a clear upgrade playbook, patch cadence options, and confirmation we can do signed bundles + offline verification. Also asked about license enforcement and what metering looks like offline. cc @marta_se

marta_se: Key q: are they running k8s with an operator or plain VMs? That changes bundle format and operator vs static manifests.

liam_sales: They said mixed environment: a small k8s cluster for services + a couple of isolated VMs for the API gateway. Operator preferred but they may need a tarball path for VMs.

owen_infra: We can produce two bundle flavors: operator-bundle (Helm/operator CRs) and flat-bundle (tarball of containers + systemd units). Main items included:
- ``manifest.json`` (bundle metadata + version)
- OCI image blobs or tarballs under ``images/``
- ``checksums.txt`` (SHA256)
- ``sbom.cyclonedx.json``
- ``bundle.ed25519`` (detached sig)
- ``license.json`` (timeboxed eval token)
- ``verify-offline.sh`` (no-network verifier)
We recommend signed SBOM + detached sig. If they require, we can attest with HSM-signed signatures (requires legal + ops setup).

claire_sec: Requirements from security POV:
- All images and manifests signed.
- Offline verification tooling that returns non-zero on tamper.
- Cert rotation flow: customer-owned CA preferred. Provide ``redwood export-cert-bundle`` which they sign and drop into cluster.
- Telemetry: default disabled for POC. Any usage logs we do include in the bundle must be opt-in and writable to a local path only.

marta_se: Upgrade cadence options to present:
1) Quarterly feature + security bundle (default POC option)
2) Monthly vetted hotfix channel (+ continuous packaging & verification testing)
3) Emergency SLA (4h) for critical CVEs and signed hotfix with expedited signing and packaging
Cost delta guidance: monthly hotfix channel ~ +12-18% seat/license; emergency SLA +10% on top of that. Final numbers from finance.

liam_sales: They also asked about rollback safety and pinning.

owen_infra: We'll include manifest pins and ``rollback.sh`` that re-applies prior manifests/images. Also provide an attestation file listing the exact image digests applied per node. For airgap, our recommended acceptance test runbook (included) will verify integrity and basic L7 checks.

marta_se: Legal/ops handshake bits: need a chain-of-custody checklist for USB handoff, signature verification steps, and a limited liability addendum for offline installs. @tom_legal please prepare a short clause.

tom_legal: Will draft a 1-page addendum: scope of support, expectations for physical transfer, liability window, and how we manage emergency patches. Also note that disabling metering may require a commercial exception.

deploy-bot: playbook-created: /playbooks/airgap-poc-ops-checklist.md assigned to owen_infra, marta_se. Due: 2026-04-06 :spiral_calendar:

liam_sales: Next actions: owen to drop a sample flat-bundle and operator-bundle to staging (expiring link) with verify script by EOD tomorrow. marta to prepare pricing band for monthly vs quarterly and emergency SLA. tom to draft addendum. I'll confirm next-week SWAT call with customer. Thanks all :thumbsup:
